Broadening this silently would make a product/scope choice beyond this review. - **Decision needed:** Decide whether the supported diagnostic contract remains hook-driven or expands to all visible DOM text. - **Likely impact:** Keeping hook-driven diagnostics preserves predictable, low-noise warnings but can miss unhooked custom text.
